content.text: Register doesn't pass a provider, so the default in `UsersService.create` applies.

candidates.explanation: When createUserDto.provider is undefined, the provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin (auth.service.ts:51) rejects any user whose provider is not 'email' and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.
Register does not set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly. It relies on the default in UsersService.create, which is wrong.

fix.description: Change the default provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email: `provider: createUserDto.provider ?? AuthProvidersEnum.email`. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register. Existing users already stored with provider 'google' need a data fix.
